video_title: Finals, trades & KAT | The Jon Krawczynski Show

quotes.speaker: Jim Souhan
quotes.summary_phrase: Anticipating a unique, perimeter-focused NBA Finals matchup
quotes.excerpt: We might see a finals with two guys who are seven-foot, shooting 25-foot shots.

text_blocks.speaker: Jim Souhan
text_blocks.text: Karl-Anthony Towns is in the finals against another very unconventional center. We might see a finals with two guys who are seven-foot, shooting 25-foot shots, maybe not venturing into the paint on offense all that often.

text_blocks.speaker: Jon Krawczynski
text_blocks.text: It is going to be really fun to watch that way, Jim, because you are right. You would look at this and say, okay, it is KAT versus Victor Wembanyama on both ends. A seven-footer against a seven-six guy, go at it.

quotes.speaker: Jon Krawczynski
quotes.summary_phrase: Defensive strategies for guarding Karl-Anthony Towns
quotes.excerpt: You will see Karl-Anthony Towns guarded a lot by Stefan Castle or a smaller player on the Spurs.
quotes.quote: You will see Karl-Anthony Towns guarded a lot by Stefan Castle or a smaller player on the Spurs because Karl will try to drag Victor Wembanyama out of the paint.

quotes.speaker: Jon Krawczynski
quotes.summary_phrase: Karl-Anthony Towns' successful evolution into a point-center role
quotes.excerpt: He went to Mike Brown and said, 'What if I, when I'm out there at the top of the key, what if I kind of run the offense?'
quotes.quote: He went to Mike Brown and said, 'What if I, when I'm out there at the top of the key, what if I kind of run the offense? What if we use my passing skills?' And it has worked brilliantly. The Knicks are on an incredible run.

quotes.speaker: Jon Krawczynski
quotes.summary_phrase: Karl-Anthony Towns' adaptability alongside different star teammates
quotes.excerpt: One of the underlooked analyses of Karl-Anthony Towns' game is how adaptable he has been.
quotes.quote: One of the underlooked analyses of Karl-Anthony Towns' game is how adaptable he has been. He comes in as the number one overall pick, a high-scoring, high-shooting player, but then Jimmy Butler comes in and he takes a side seat to Jimmy. Anthony Edwards comes in, he shares the spotlight with him. Rudy Gobert comes in and he really switches positions entirely and plays a different way to accommodate Rudy.

quotes.speaker: Jon Krawczynski
quotes.summary_phrase: Debunking the whisper campaign against Karl-Anthony Towns
quotes.excerpt: I always heard the whisper campaign and I always looked for signs that it might be true, and I never came across any actual evidence.
quotes.quote: I always heard the whisper campaign and I always looked for signs that it might be true, and I never came across any actual evidence that it was true. So I am just wondering, as someone who knew him well and might have heard the same things, what you think about that whole realm.

quotes.speaker: Jon Krawczynski
quotes.summary_phrase: Anticipating significant roster changes for the Timberwolves
quotes.excerpt: I think there is going to be some sort of fairly significant roster change.
quotes.quote: I think there is going to be some sort of fairly significant roster change, so that the starting lineup on opening night next season is not going to be the same starting lineup that finished this season.

quotes.speaker: Jon Krawczynski
quotes.summary_phrase: Evaluating the risks of trading for Kawhi Leonard
quotes.excerpt: I would be reticent to do it. I wouldn't completely close the door on it, but I'd have a lot of questions answered before I went ahead with Kawhi Leonard.
quotes.quote: I would be reticent to do it. I wouldn't completely close the door on it, but I'd have a lot of questions answered before I went ahead with Kawhi Leonard. Same with Kyrie Irving, he has his injury issues. I think Anthony Davis, if I were the Timberwolves, I'd look at him a little bit. Is this a possibility to maybe buy a little lower on an extremely talented guy? But guess what, he's got injury issues.

quotes.speaker: Jon Krawczynski
quotes.summary_phrase: Assessing Zion Williamson as a potential trade target
quotes.excerpt: Every time Zion Williamson plays the Timberwolves, he absolutely kicks their ass.
quotes.quote: Every time Zion Williamson plays the Timberwolves, he absolutely kicks their ass. And you are like, this is the best player in the league. This is who you see. But he is another buy-low candidate, I think. And you could make the argument, and I think there is a good argument, of okay, if you move Julius Randle for Zion and you put him next to Rudy Gobert and Jaden McDaniels, then you would say, any sort of defensive concerns that we have about Zion Williamson are mitigated because of the guys that we have around him.

quotes.speaker: Jon Krawczynski
quotes.summary_phrase: Reflecting on Rick Adelman's coaching legacy
quotes.excerpt: He was a great coach, brilliant offensive coach.
quotes.quote: He was a great coach, brilliant offensive coach. I always found him when he was here to be a little bit aloof. I didn't really get to know him very well. He kept you at arm's length a little bit more than some of the other coaches that have come through here, but I always had an incredible amount of respect for him because he was never combative, never belittling, never disrespectful to what job we had to do.

quotes.speaker: Jon Krawczynski
quotes.summary_phrase: The human side of Rick Adelman
quotes.excerpt: The times that you saw the humanity from Rick Adelman was every time he was talking to Mary Kay.
quotes.quote: The times that you saw the humanity from Rick Adelman was every time he was talking to Mary Kay, talking about her. He was this very sort of crusty, curmudgeonly old coach, but there was always a moment before each game where he would walk out onto the sideline and he would look up into the stands and he would find Mary Kay and he would wave and his eyes and his face lit up.

quotes.speaker: Jon Krawczynski
quotes.summary_phrase: The reality of NBA dynasties in the modern era
quotes.excerpt: The season is long and injuries can happen. Money issues can come into things.
quotes.quote: The season is long and injuries can happen. Money issues can come into things. When teams win at a high level, ego gets involved sometimes. Roles get battled for. Any number of things can happen between this time and this time next year to make it that San Antonio does not repeat. It is far more likely that San Antonio does not win again next year, even if they win this year, than it is that they are back in it.

quotes.speaker: Jon Krawczynski
quotes.summary_phrase: The impact of the new CBA on team building
quotes.excerpt: The landscape of the WNBA has changed dramatically over the last couple of months with the new collective bargaining agreement.
quotes.quote: The landscape of the WNBA has changed dramatically over the last couple of months with the new collective bargaining agreement, with the new salaries. Considering that Alex and Marc also own the Lynx, do you think the costs associated with running the Lynx could affect their willingness and ability to spend more on the Wolves in the future? It is a good question because certainly the landscape of the WNBA has changed dramatically. What I would say though, and what players would tell you, is that the reason that they are making more money is because they are bringing in more revenue for the league.

quotes.speaker: Jon Krawczynski
quotes.summary_phrase: The impact of Olivia Miles on the Minnesota Lynx
quotes.excerpt: Olivia Miles is a story of the season. She's an incredible player.
quotes.quote: Olivia Miles is a story of the season. She's an incredible player. She was the MVP of the EuroLeague. She's going to come in and have a big impact. Olivia Miles is a story of the season. She's an incredible player. Cheryl Reeve just keeps on figuring out ways and finding ways to stay relevant and not fall back to the pack.
